settings.title: Fluid Regulation
settings.text: Your body balances fluids through a complex system of organs and electrolytes.

settings.title: Natural Support
settings.text: Certain vitamins, minerals, and botanicals can help support this natural process.*

settings.title: Everyday Balance
settings.text: Diet, activity, and daily habits all play a part in how your body manages fluids.

settings.title: Electrolytes
settings.text: Minerals like potassium and chloride help maintain proper fluid balance in the body.*

settings.image_alt: Illustration of a woman’s figure made of clear blue water inside a water bubble with green leaves
settings.heading:
Understanding
Fluid Balance.
settings.text: Your body constantly works to maintain the right balance of fluids and electrolytes. Factors like diet, activity level, travel, hormonal changes, and environmental conditions can sometimes lead to temporary water retention, leaving you feeling bloated, sluggish, or uncomfortable.
